description: Copies the textual content of a target component to the clipboard.

attributes.name: copied-text
attributes.description: Accessible feedback text after a successful copy; defaults to Copied!.

attributes.name: error-icon
attributes.description: Icon name displayed after a failed clipboard copy; defaults to warning.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: ID of the element whose source text is copied, without a leading #.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Icon name displayed before copying; defaults to copy.

attributes.name: success-icon
attributes.description: Icon name displayed after a successful copy; defaults to check.

methods.name: copy(): Promise<boolean>
methods.description: Copies the target source text to the clipboard. Resolves to true on success, or false when the target is missing or copying fails; updates feedback and emits the corresponding result event.

events.name: tp-copy-code-error
events.description: Emitted when the target cannot be resolved or its contents cannot be copied; message explains the failure.

events.name: tp-copy-code-success
events.description: Emitted after clipboard writing succeeds. The detail gives the copied text length in UTF-16 code units and the source element.

cssproperties.name: --tp-copy-code-error-color
cssproperties.description: Color of the copy control while reporting a failed clipboard operation.

cssproperties.name: --tp-copy-code-success-color
cssproperties.description: Color of the copy control while confirming a successful clipboard operation.

dependencies.name: tp-animation
dependencies.summary: Applies an animation to a target element.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-copy-code>` element implements the <tp-icon name="copy-code" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Copy code functionality: copies the textual content of a target component to the clipboard.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Copy button | Copy the associated text. On code blocks, the button appears at the top right on hover or keyboard focus. |
| Check mark | Temporarily confirms that the copy succeeded. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
